_note: Placeholder slots until MW4's real camos are known: every weapon has 8 Military camos (itemId 0-7: the same set on every weapon in this mode, unlocked by weapon level, no challenge) then 3 Special camos (itemId 8-10: unique per weapon, a weapon level then a challenge). Fill in names, unlockLevel, requirement and imageURL as they are announced; keep the itemIds. Then Completionist (the `completionist` block): Gold, Platinum, Harmonic Break, each with a challenge (per weapon category under byCategory), and a final camo earned once the weapon has its Harmonic Break and the mode has final.harmonicBreaksNeeded of them (not published yet, so unset: the weapon's own Harmonic Break is enough). Mastery 1-3 is mode-wide: unlocked as weapons earn the final camo (mastery.tierN.weaponsNeeded; unset = a third, two thirds, all of the launch roster). Multiplayer's challenges are from leaks, not official.
